baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired causatives yuhyi and yumit are followed by qada amran and the kun/fa-yakun sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: Entry into life and exit from it are opposite transitions governed by one agent. The move from settling an affair to its occurrence presents both transitions as instances of one executable causal architecture.

activation_trace.role: Animate life supplies the positive endpoint of the paired transition.
Loss of life and force supplies the opposed endpoint controlled by the same subject.
The sense of fashioning and carrying an act through makes the affair executable rather than merely contemplated.
Occurrence and presence provide the realized state reached by the command.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists two opposite divine powers and then adds a separate creation formula.
changed_reading.after: Life and death are the two boundary transitions of the same settlement-to-occurrence mechanism.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restrictive fa-innama links yaqulu lahu directly to the imperative kun and its consequence fa-yakun.
baseline_models.mechanism: The saying does not report a future event. It addresses an affair with an obligating imperative, and the addressee's occurrence is the immediate functional completion of that speech.

activation_trace.role: Voiced saying supplies the act of address whose force is tested by what follows.
Obligating command gives the utterance directive rather than descriptive force.
Coming into occurrence functions as the command's realized complement.

changed_reading.before: God verbally announces what will subsequently happen.
changed_reading.after: The saying itself is performative address: its commanded content and its realization form one causal event.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Qada governs amran before the saying and becoming sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus permits judgment, closure, completion, and executed making to coexist within qada. Amr can therefore be the affair placed under decisive settlement, not only the command later quoted.

activation_trace.role: Cutting judgment contributes the closure of alternatives.
Completion and finishing contribute the terminal aspect of the settlement.
An affair or state supplies the case that is closed and executed.

changed_reading.before: Qada means only that God chooses for an object to exist.
changed_reading.after: Qada closes an affair to alternatives and carries it to completion; kun is the execution point of that settlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly stages human disputation as an entangled attempt to unsettle truth, while the focus allows no argumentative interval between divine address and realization. The restrictive construction thus marks not only speed but resistance to rhetorical displacement.

activation_trace.role: The focus saying supplies the speech act contrasted with contested human discourse.
Actual occurrence leaves no gap in which counter-speech can prevent the result.
Intertwined adversarial argument supplies the counter-model of speech struggling against speech.
Loss of truth and stability identifies the unstable material used in that struggle.
The image of making an argument fall supplies the attempted directional action against truth.
Stable correspondence to reality supplies what disputation fails to remove.
Being turned away immediately after the focus supplies the consequence of refusing the unbroken command-to-event relation.

structural_cues: 40:5 uses a purpose chain in which disputation with falsehood aims to dislodge truth and is then reversed by divine seizure.
40:69 follows the focus immediately and returns to disputing the signs and being turned away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies frustrated rhetorical struggle, stable truth, and immediate post-focus diversion; I infer that fa-innama and fa-yakun exclude counter-speech from the causal interval. A live alternative is that the focus only asserts effortless power without commenting on disputation.

changed_reading.before: The formula says that creation is quick.
changed_reading.after: The formula says that settled divine speech is non-negotiable: unlike disputation, it cannot be twisted so as to displace its result.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier confession counts death and enlivening twice. That recurrence changes the focus pair from a one-way biological span into repeatable boundary operations, making renewed life after death internal to the stated power.

activation_trace.role: Animate life anchors each positive crossing of the boundary.
Departure of life anchors each negative crossing.
The context applies caused death as a counted, repeatable transition.
The context applies caused life as the matching repeated return to animation.

structural_cues: 40:11 repeats the dual count after both causatives and then asks whether there is a route of exit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two counted deaths and two counted enlivenings; I infer that the focus verbs name reusable transition operators rather than one birth and one terminal death. The exact identification of all counted phases remains open.

changed_reading.before: He gives one earthly life and ends it once.
changed_reading.after: He controls every crossing into and out of life, including a return to life after a prior death.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first reserves effective judgment in truth to God, then later repeats the amr/qada configuration under a matching temporal construction and makes the result a truth-based separation in which falsifiers lose. The focus's kun/fa-yakun can therefore execute a verdict as well as originate a creature.

activation_trace.role: Decisive judgment anchors the focus affair as a case capable of adjudication.
The affair sense provides the matter placed under judgment.
Occurrence makes the verdict effective in reality rather than merely announced.
The paired occurrence contrasts God's effective judgment with the inability of invoked rivals to judge.
Reality-matching stability specifies the norm of the effective judgment.
The arriving divine affair reactivates the same object domain as the focus.
Passive decisive judgment supplies the surah's explicit later realization of the focus collocation.
Stable truth marks the criterion by which the affair is settled.
Those lacking truth and stability supply the losing side produced by the settlement.

structural_cues: 40:20 contrasts God's truth-based qada with the negated qada of invoked others.
40:78 repeats idha, amr, qada, and truth language, then states a differentiated loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a unique divine judge and a later near-recurrence of the focus construction with an explicit verdict; I infer that becoming is one mode by which judgment is made real. A live alternative is to keep creative and judicial senses parallel without allowing either to color the other.

changed_reading.before: The settled affair is only a creative decision about existence.
changed_reading.after: The settled affair may be a truth-disclosing verdict, and kun/fa-yakun is the event that enforces its separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A ruling group earlier voices an order that pairs killing sons with selectively keeping women alive. The focus reunites effective saying, enlivening, and causing death under the divine subject, exposing the political order as coercive selection within lives it does not ultimately originate or own.

activation_trace.role: Selective preservation from killing lets the focus verb answer the regime's earlier survival policy.
True causation of death supplies the authority the human killers imitate but do not possess.
Effective divine saying provides the counterpoint to a ruler's voiced coercive order.
Human speech launches the attempted allocation of death and survival.
Taking life supplies the coercive negative half of the regime's paired policy.
Keeping a selected population alive supplies the coercive positive half of that policy.

structural_cues: 40:25 coordinates the two imperatives to kill and keep alive under one preceding human saying.
40:26 immediately repeats the ruler's desire to kill and frames it as protection of his order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a human speech act that distributes killing and survival; I infer that the focus deliberately reclaims that paired field for the one whose speech yields existence itself. The live alternative is that the verbal overlap is thematic rather than polemically targeted.

changed_reading.before: The life/death claim is an abstract statement of metaphysical omnipotence.
changed_reading.after: It also strips regimes of their claim to allocate life and death: their orders only act within a life field established by the effective divine command.

context_deltas.mechanism: The believer's saying hands his affair over to God, and the next verse reports protection as consequence. This activates amr in the focus as an entrusted concrete case: qada can be providential settlement of an affair whose human holder has relinquished control.

activation_trace.role: Decisive settlement anchors what happens to the entrusted case.
The affair sense permits a concrete human case to sit within the focus construction.
The believer's spoken declaration performs the handover rather than merely describing it.
Returning an affair to another in reliance supplies the transfer of agency.
The possessive affair is the concrete object transferred for settlement.
Protection from harm supplies the narrated outcome following the handover.

structural_cues: 40:44 ends with entrusting a first-person affair, and 40:45 begins with a consequential protection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies handover, affair, and subsequent protection; I infer a causal arrow from relinquished agency to divine settlement of the case. A live alternative is that the protection illustrates divine sight rather than the semantics of qada amran.

changed_reading.before: Amran denotes only a cosmic object of creation.
changed_reading.after: Amran can include a lived affair entrusted to God, with qada naming its providential closure and execution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Lord's earlier saying establishes a compact call-and-answer sequence. Read beside it, the focus's saying, imperative, and becoming form a nonverbal call-and-response structure in which existence is the addressee's answer.

activation_trace.role: The focus saying initiates an address sequence.
Directive force turns the address into a summons to a state.
Occurrence supplies the nonverbal answer that fulfills the summons.
A divine saying introduces the context's explicit response pattern.
Calling by speech supplies the initiating side of that pattern.
A returned answer supplies the reciprocal completion mapped onto fa-yakun.

structural_cues: 40:60 places divine saying, an imperative call, and promised response in one short sequence.
40:68 likewise places saying, an imperative, and a fa-marked result in one short sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two parallel compact sequences; I infer that occurrence can be heard as the created addressee's answer. A live alternative is that 40:60 is reciprocal communication while 40:68 remains unilateral causation.

changed_reading.before: Fa-yakun is merely the external effect of a causal utterance.
changed_reading.after: Fa-yakun is also the affair's answer: it responds to address by presenting itself in existence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah unfolds human creation through material attachment, emergence, repeated attainment, becoming old, early taking, and an appointed limit. This makes the focus's decisive command compatible with a temporally articulated trajectory: decree secures that the process becomes, not necessarily that every phase lacks duration.

activation_trace.role: Executed making anchors the decree as control of a realized process.
Occurrence is the assured result whose internal temporal articulation remains open.
Measured formation supplies an ordered starting architecture rather than an unstructured instant.
A minute reproductive fluid supplies one material phase in the trajectory.
Implantation and persistence in the womb supply a dependent developmental phase.
Repeated arrival at an endpoint supplies staged maturation and final-term orientation.
Becoming a later life-state demonstrates that kawn can name transition within an existing process.
Taking the self supplies an alternate termination before the full listed trajectory.
A fixed temporal limit supplies the trajectory's bounded horizon.

structural_cues: 40:67 immediately precedes the focus and repeats thumma across successive material and life stages.
The same ayah uses two attainment clauses, a becoming clause, an early-death exception, and a named term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, repeated staging, and a decisive command formula; I infer that certainty of enactment need not imply absence of mediated duration. A live alternative is that kun describes only origination while the stages describe what follows after origination.

changed_reading.before: Kun fa-yakun means every commanded result is temporally instantaneous and processless.
changed_reading.after: Kun fa-yakun guarantees the transition and its whole trajectory; what decisively becomes may still unfold through measured stages.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant q-w-l to q-l-l mapping and the later explicit q-l-l cue, not a standard derivation claim. It remains anchored in the focus saying, the restrictive particle, and a supplied branch for smallness. Downstream prose should label it a form-distant activation: the least utterance suffices, not an etymology of qawl.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus restricts the causal speech to the single imperative kun.

activation_trace.role: The split target's smallness image recasts the saying as a minimal sufficient verbal impulse.
An explicit later occurrence of littleness activates the non-dominant focus mapping within the same surah.
Full occurrence supplies the maximal result set against the minimal verbal input.

changed_reading.before: Effective creation requires a fully elaborated verbal act.
changed_reading.after: The least possible utterance is causally sufficient: a single clipped imperative opens into full occurrence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because it extends life and death from organisms to land, provision, motion, and rest. It remains valid as an activation because the focus inventories themselves include rain-fed land-life and death-like stilling, while the surah supplies descending provision and nocturnal cessation. Render it as a systems analogy alongside, not instead of, literal animate life and death.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus pairs causing life with causing death before generalizing to commanded occurrence.

activation_trace.role: Rain-fed animation of land broadens enlivening into ecological activation.
Stilling and dormancy broaden death into temporary quiescence.
Delivered descent supplies the vertical input that can activate the land system.
Rain understood as provision makes the descending input explicitly life-supporting.
Cessation of movement at night supplies a recurring quiescent phase rather than final extinction.

changed_reading.before: Life and death refer only to the start and end of animal organisms.
changed_reading.after: They can also trace a recurrent pulse of activation and quiescence across land, sustenance, bodily motion, and rest.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The oddity is that the focus addresses an 'it' before fa-yakun presents its occurrence. Whole-surah references to every thing as encompassed and created keep the inference anchored, but the packet does not settle the ontology of a not-yet-manifest object. Downstream prose should frame this as an addressability model, not as a definitive claim about pre-existence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Yaqulu lahu gives the commanded affair pronominal addressability before fa-yakun states occurrence.

activation_trace.role: A thing's own signification as saying supports manifestation as a legible response.
Occurrence marks the shift from addressability to manifested presence.
A thing as something knowable and reportable supports intelligibility within encompassing knowledge.
The same knowable-thing image under universal creation links addressability to created manifestation.

changed_reading.before: The command can only address an object that is already constituted.
changed_reading.after: The affair is addressable as a known thing before manifestation, and its coming-to-be is the outward sign of that address.

strongest_changes: The immediate 40:67 sequence makes decisive kun compatible with a measured, multi-stage trajectory.
The qada/amr recurrence at 40:20 and 40:78 turns becoming into possible enforcement of a truth-based verdict.
The killing and selective sparing order at 40:25 makes the life/death claim a political reclamation as well as a metaphysical assertion.
The double life/death confession at 40:11 changes the pair into repeatable transitions that include renewed life.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence separated several mechanisms that a local reading could collapse: performative speech, judicial settlement, staged creation, entrusted affairs, and contested political speech. The split q-w-l to q-l-l target also preserved a contained minimal-utterance outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: 40:67 may show the process governed by the command or only an example that precedes a separately instantaneous formula.
The judicial and creative senses of qada may mutually activate while remaining distinct rather than forming one mechanism.
The response model, ecological pulse, premanifest addressability, and minimal-utterance reading remain analogical or form-distant and should not displace the stronger models.
